illustration.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a wide illustrated footer panorama for a family safety mobile app named Kids4Safe. Create ONLY the illustration, no UI, no text, no logos. Soft polished hand-painted digital illustration: a mother seen from behind seated with her young son, her arm gently around his shoulders, placed in the right third, facing a peaceful distant city skyline and rolling hills. Rounded leafy plants frame both lower corners, soft clouds and a few tiny birds, gentle morning light. Palette icy white #F1F8FF sky fading to white at the entire top edge, layered muted light blues and turquoise #20B9BE landscapes, navy #0B2454 foliage, blue clothes, natural warm skin and brown hair. Trustworthy, protective, affectionate, contemporary family brand. Very wide horizontal composition, 3:1 aspect ratio, no borders. Keep all figures safely inside canvas with space above heads, top quarter mostly pale sky. Detailed but restrained, suitable for mobile onboarding, serene rather than childish.
